content:
[Intro]
Hey
where's my paper?
Hey you,
get back here!

[Interlude]

[Verse 1]
[D#5]Mad at the [D5]papaer boy [F#5]that little [D5]nerd
[D#5]Can't throw [D5]a paper [F#5]straight, the [D5]spastic twerp
[D#5]Hit me [D5]in the head [F#5]with the [D5]Daily Sun
[D#5]Then he laughed [D5]like a [F#5]maniac, the smart [D5]ass runt

[Chorus]
[C5]Mad at the paper boy [F#5]
[C5]Mad at the paper boy [F#5]
[C5]Mad at the paper boy [F#5]
[C5]Mad at the paper boy [F#5]

[Interlude]
[D#5]  [D5]  [F#5]  [D5]
[D#5]  [D5]  [F#5]  [D5]

[Verse 2]
[D#5]Mad at the [D5]paper boy, [F#5]I'm really not [D5]amused
[D#5]Gotta wear a football [D5]helmet if I [F#5]wanna read [D5]the news
[D#5]He threw [D5]the morning paper [F#5]in the middle [D5]of the grass
[D#5]Then he rode [D5]by on his bicycle [F#5]and kicked [D5]me in the ass

[Chorus]
[C5]Mad at the paper boy [F#5]
[C5]Mad at the paper boy [F#5]
[C5]Mad at the paper boy [F#5]
[C5]Mad at the paper boy [F#5]

[Bridge]
[D#5][D5][F#5][D5]OI!
[D#5][D5][F#5][D5]Arrgh!
[D#5][D5][F#5]HIT [D5]THE
[D#5]DECK!! [D5][F#5][D5]

[Chorus]
[C5]Mad at the paper boy [F#5]
[C5]Mad at the paper boy [F#5]
[C5]Mad at the paper boy [F#5]
[C5]Mad at the paper boy [F#5]

[Outro]
[D#5][D5][F#5][D5]OI!

title: Mad at the Paper Boy
tuning: E A D G B E
